campaign.title: Cabin in the Ashen Veil
campaign.status: Campaign design / continuity recovery; not repository-synchronized or Foundry-verified
campaign.format: Multi-session horror campaign (began as Halloween one-shot concept)

setting.historicalBackdrop: Mount Hotenow catastrophe and Ash Zombie attack, 1451 DR

storyThreads.name: Active ritual
storyThreads.summary: Maldrath Voss attempts to summon Vharzagul; final-site and encounter logic remain partly open.

storyThreads.name: Older family haunting
storyThreads.summary: Five sentient haunts predate the ritual; players infer the family story from clues.

haunts.name: The Crooked Man
haunts.motive: Tries to retrieve/wrangle children and return them to safety.

haunts.name: The Eyeless Girl
haunts.motive: Longs to see again; not a combat ally.

haunts.name: The Shadow That Sees
haunts.motive: Appears to be admired; source-less flat wall shadow with an eye.

haunts.name: The Null Child
haunts.identity: Incomplete consciousness of the unborn child lost to miscarriage
haunts.motive: Cosmic-horror projection; not intentionally tactical or guaranteed harmless.

haunts.name: The House That Loves
haunts.identity: The father’s protective will infused into the house
haunts.motive: Protects its haunt-family from the summoner and resists their leaving.

milestones.trigger: Sluice, basement, Aqueduct, first Crooked Man chase.
Second Crooked Man chase at NW Sune bust on later return.
Charge the recovered Gondian power source at Aqueduct station.

currentMajorDependencies: Four Sune busts (SW → NE → NW → SE) reveal sliding relief → 1,000 gp and Brass Key → Study.
Study note 587 → Donovan shack lockbox → sluice crank → pond drains → Weathered Key → basement.
Clockwork Winder (attic, per 2026-10-20 audit) + four busts; the order clue remains open.
Tiny Key/hour hand + attic minute hand → chimney clock at noon → replacement gear.
Basement workshop repair tool → parents’ nightstand drawer → Aqueduct gate handle; gear + handle opens Aqueduct.
First Rufus eye from Sophia’s bear + late second eye → uncharged Gondian power source → Aqueduct charger → Crimson Veil.
Six storybooks / Spine Mosaic → Gond emblem half; Boathouse prayer / Sune shrine → Sune half.
Basement access + charged power + two joined emblem halves → final vault → Scrying Bowl.
Scrying Bowl + Great Room 027 water-filled Dust of Dryness pellet → Undercroft access.
